Table 5 presents estimates of quantiles for potential outcomes and QTE. One noticeable observation is that for SCCG women; quantiles (q 0.5) of birth weight from smokers are remarkably higher compared to those for the entire sample or other subgroups; while their nonsmokers' birth weight quantiles are similar to those in other groups. This leads to the lower quantile smoking effects for this college education group compared to other groups at low quantiles. low
